name: Microsoft Teams Bridge by StandIn
description: Put your OpenClaw agent in a real Microsoft Teams call: it sees your screen-share and camera, holds a live spoken conversation, and appears as a lip-synced avatar. Realtime speech-to-speech or streaming STT-to-TTS, meeting recaps, outbound call-backs, HMAC-secured.

path.description: WebSocket path for the calling lane (default /msteams/calling).

secret.description: The StandIn connection secret. ONE value covering BOTH lanes, calling and messages. Paste the value the StandIn portal shows you.

maxVisionPerMinute.description: Per-call cap on paid vision calls over a sliding 60 seconds, shared by look_at_screen, the ambient push and the streaming per-turn attach (default 30). 0 turns vision spend OFF - it is the kill switch, NOT unlimited. There is no unlimited setting; set a large number if you want a cap that never bites.

ambientVision.description: Keep pushing the newest changed camera / screen-share frame at the model between turns, so it stays visually aware without being asked. Off by default: it spends a vision call per scene change for the whole call. look_at_screen works either way.

responseModel.description: Optional `provider/model` override for the consult and task lanes, e.g. `microsoft-foundry/gpt-5.6-sol`. Omit to inherit `agents.defaults.model.primary`. Set it when the voice lane should consult a different model than your default agent.

agentId.description: Which agent the consult and recap lanes run against. Defaults to `main`.

responseTimeoutMs.description: How long a consult may take before the caller is told it timed out, in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.

tts.description: Text-to-speech settings for the streaming path, passed through to the host TTS runtime unchanged. Ignored in `realtime` mode, where the realtime provider speaks.

managedBot.description: COMPATIBILITY block for the messages lane. Prefer the flat keys beside the calling ones (messagesPort / messagesPath) - they are the two lanes of one connection, not a sub-product, and the top-level `secret` covers both. Still read so an existing config keeps working.

enabled.description: Optional EXPLICIT override. The lane is enabled by the presence of a secret, so this is only needed as `false` to keep it off while a secret is configured.

port.description: HTTP port for the managed chat endpoint (default 9444).

chatSecret.description: Per-lane secret for messages. Prefer the top-level `secret`, which covers both lanes.

messagesPort.description: HTTP port for the messages lane (default 9444).

messagesPath.description: POST path for the messages lane (default /msteams/messages).

gatewayReplyUrl.description: Where replies are posted. Defaults to the StandIn gateway; override only for a self-hosted StandIn. Set it at the root, beside the other messages-lane keys.

callingPort.description: WebSocket port for the calling lane (default 9442). `port` is the older name and still works.

messagesBindAddress.description: Bind address for the messages lane. Defaults to the root `bindAddress`, so both lanes share one interface; set this only to split them.

transcribeVoiceMessages.description: Transcribe inbound Teams voice messages and fold the text into the agent's turn. Off by default: each clip costs an STT call, and a voice note can be minutes long.
